Cadastral map showing numbered and unnumbered lots; some householders' and lot owners' names shown.

Cadastral map showing numbered and unnumbered lots; some householders' and lot owners' names shown. Shows radial distances from railway depot in Winter Park. Includes text and table of statistical information on lots. Inset: Map of Florida, 1884. Text and ill. on verso. Imperfect: Brittle, stained, with tears and some small holes. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Acquisitions control no. 2005-79
Contributors: Photo Electro. Co; Robinson, S. A. (Surveyor); Winter Park Floridian (Firm)
